# infisical_pam_group (Resource)

Manage a group's membership in Infisical PAM. A group must be a PAM member before it can be added to folders or accounts. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

data "infisical_groups" "all" {}

resource "infisical_pam_group" "solengs" {
  group_id = one([for group in data.infisical_groups.all.groups : group.id if group.slug == "solengs"])
  role     = "member"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The ID of the group. Changing it creates a new membership.
- `role` (String) The role in PAM: `admin` or `member`. Members only get the access their folder and account memberships grant.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the membership.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the group's PAM membership by the group ID
terraform import infisical_pam_group.example <group_id>
```
